title: Rehearsal Dinners
seoDescription: Plan rehearsal dinners and wedding weekend events at Cococabana in Oceanside.
heroText: A coastal rooftop setting for wedding weekend gatherings.

heroImage.alt: Coco Cabana rooftop lounge with pink daybeds, tile wall, and Oceanside city views at dusk

sections.title: The Night Before the Big Day
features: Intimate setting for the wedding party
text: Fill out the inquiry form below or call us directly to talk through your date, party size, and what you're envisioning. We'll put together the details and make it work for your group.
sections.imageAlt: Women dining and celebrating on Coco Cabana rooftop with cocktails and palm views

sections.title:
The Rooftop
Is Yours
text: Four stories above 408 Pier View Way — open air, full bar, and a Pacific coastline view that makes the night before feel just as special as the day itself.
sections.imageAlt: Coco Cabana rooftop lounge seating with rattan pendants, tile wall, and Oceanside views

sections.title: Set the Tone for the Weekend
text:
Palm trees, open sky, cabana seating, and Caribbean cocktails — the rooftop at Coco Cabana creates an atmosphere that needs no additional decoration. Just show up and let it do the work.

Whether you want a low-key dinner with the wedding party or a full rooftop gathering with the whole crew, we can put together something that fits the occasion. Just reach out and we'll make it happen.
sections.imageAlt: Coco Cabana rooftop packed with guests at golden hour — full venue energy

steps.title: Inquire Below
steps.text: Fill out the inquiry form with your rehearsal dinner date, party size, and what you'd like the evening to look like. Or call us at (858) 304-7725.

steps.title: We Build the Plan
steps.text: We'll follow up within 1 business day to confirm availability and put together the details — space, bar, and anything else that makes the evening feel right.

steps.title: Enjoy the Rooftop
steps.text: Show up, settle in, and let the rooftop do the rest. We'll handle everything so you can enjoy the night before the big day.
